title: Two long folders that differ at their end paint the same tab text
why: title_galleys cuts the place from its tail at 118 px (tab_bar/mod.rs:219-220) and then the name to what is left, so what tells two tabs apart is the first thing lost. The existing test asserts only that each tab starts 'Notes · corr' and ends with an ellipsis (same_name.rs:228-242), which pins the defect. The accessible names do differ.
observable: Two tabs read 'Notes · correspondenc…' and nothing on screen tells them apart until one is pointed at.
size: 2 files (src/tab/names/mod.rs, src/app/tab_bar/mod.rs), about 60 lines; src/tab/names/tests.rs grows; 1 reader test rewritten
guards: tests/reader/same_name.rs a_long_folder_leaves_the_start_of_the_name_in_view must be rewritten to assert the two tabs read differently. Complexity cap 15 on the new function; coverage of its branches. PR 23 conflicts textually in tab_label.
repro: reproduced: `assertion left != right failed: both tabs paint the same words  left: "Notes · correspondenc…"  right: "Notes · correspondenc…"`, for folders ending -1998 and -2004 and for monday.md and tuesday.md in one long folder

options.name: Elide in names what the clashing places share and keep a pixel cap as the last resort
options.cost: About 60 lines and new unit tests; tabs stay within 200 px; an extreme pair can still read alike.

options.name: Elide in names with a character budget and no pixel cap
options.cost: Same size; a pathological folder can push a tab past 200 px.

options.name: Cut the place from its head in the row
options.cost: About 20 lines, but egui only truncates tails, so it needs a measured loop when names change, and folders that differ in the middle still read alike.

title: Every watcher batch works all tab names out again, reloaded or not
why: watching/mod.rs:248 calls tab_names_changed after the loop unconditionally. A name depends on a tab's first heading and path, which only a reload changes. reload_tabs_showing returns whether the front tab reloaded, so it needs a second signal for 'any tab reloaded'.
guards: tests/reader/same_name.rs and live_reload.rs. PR 21 rewrites reload_tabs_showing (follow_disk), a textual conflict.

title: Every edit works all tab names out again, and every candidate builds all its longer names up front
why: content/mod.rs:132 calls tab_names_changed on each edit, and Candidate::new builds one ShownName for every folder depth of every tab (names/mod.rs:73-80) whether or not the tab clashes. Comparing the tab's name before and after content_edited gates the first; a depth counter built on demand fixes the second.
guards: src/tab/names/tests.rs (257 lines) pins every output of shown_names and needs no change. Coverage of the new branch in content/mod.rs.

title: A tab stores two names that depend on every other open tab, kept true by convention
why: Tab::shown and Tab::shown_file (tab/mod.rs:128-133) are written only by name_tabs, and all five mutation paths call tab_names_changed today (tab_documents_changed, begin_session, the edit, the watcher batch, and through them open and close). Moving the names to the app is the wider refactor the review asks for in a PR of its own.
diff:
sketch, not compiled
- shown: ShownName,
- shown_file: ShownName,
+ // MarkdownApp: tab_names: Vec<TabNames>, rebuilt by tab_names_changed
guards: Every reader test on tab names; src/app/close_prompt (question), frame/mod.rs (title), tab_bar.

options.name: Leave the fields on Tab for now
options.cost: Nothing; a sixth mutation path that forgets tab_names_changed shows a stale name.

options.name: Move the names to the app in a PR of its own
options.cost: About 60 lines in 6 files, no behaviour change; conflicts with PRs 21 and 23 while they are open.

title: shown_file is a ShownName but only its text is ever read
why: Tab::shown_file() returns self.shown_file.as_str() (tab/mod.rs) and nothing calls parts() on it; the window title and the prompt's question take the string.
diff:
sketch, not compiled
- shown_file: ShownName,
+ shown_file: String,

title: ShownName::parts hides an invariant behind a fallback that cannot run
why: parts() is split_at_checked(name_len).unwrap_or(..) and name_len is always name.len() of the prefix (names/mod.rs:27-40, 49-52), so the fallback is dead and is an uncovered region. Storing two halves alone does not work: as_str() must return the whole as one &str for the accessible name and for the clash map. Keep whole and store the place's start, or store all three.
guards: src/tab/names/tests.rs; the coverage gate (the fallback region is not covered today).

title: A tabs test asserts around the temp folder's name
why: tabs_depth.rs:255-259 checks starts_with("tab:Long read · ") and ends_with("/long.md") because the place between is the scratch folder. Putting both fixtures in a named folder makes the names exact ('Long read · docs/long.md').
guards: Test-only; the exact names change if 27-F1 elides what the two places share.
